raw_tokens.value: RacialTraits.Fetchling Racial Trait.Fetchling Racial Default.SpecialQuality.Racial Language

Fetchlings begin play speaking Common. Fetchlings with a high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Aquan, Auran, Draconic, D'ziriak (understanding only, cannot speak), Ignan, Terran, and any regional human tongue.
